Vehicle to vehicle communication using LIFI: 2025 
Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) communication using Li-Fi (Light Fidelity) is a modern wireless communication technology that uses 
visible light instead of radio waves to transfer data between vehicles. In this system, LED headlights and taillights act as 
transmitters, and photodiodes act as receivers. This helps vehicles share information such as speed, position, and distance in 
real time. 
Li-Fi-based V2V communication provides high data speed, low interference, and better security compared to traditional Wi- 
Fi or radio-based systems. It can help in reducing road accidents, improving traffic management, and enhancing driver safety 
by enabling vehicles to communicate instantly and accurately. 
 
 
 
CERTIFICATIONS 
 
 
C++ programing 
VLSI design 
Solar panal system 
Bosh traning certificate
